about: Virtues the «صاحب المنقبة» quiz does not ask, keyed by the virtue's id (unit#assertion), each with why. They stay on the person's page. A virtue goes here when another person in the app could rightly be its answer too: general praise («من كبراء الصحابة», «من أشراف قومه»), or one shared by a group. The batch threads add to it when they read the generated questions (conversion GUIDE.md, check 4).

skip.siyar-v3-abu-bakr#a_ab_v_first: Ali's entry (Khulafa' p227-228) reports that Ali accepted Islam before Abu Bakr, so Ali could be taken for the answer.
skip.siyar-v3-abu-bakr#a_ab_v_khayr: Names Abu Bakr and Umar together; Umar is also a right answer.
skip.siyar-v3-umar#a_u_v_wazir: Names Abu Bakr and Umar together as the two viziers; Abu Bakr is also a right answer.
skip.siyar-v3-umar#a_u_v_iqtadu: Names Abu Bakr and Umar together; Abu Bakr is also a right answer.
skip.siyar-v3-uthman#a_o_v_hijratayn: Others in the app made both hijrahs too (Ja'far and the Abyssinia migrants).
